corrections: T3 Code is the best source for idempotent command receipts, not for multi-replica safety. Its engine is a single-process, single-writer in-memory queue and read model; only the receipts and events are durable in SQL. No reference implements multi-replica run control: DeepSeek only documents that it is process-local, so C-057 is effectively 0 of 12 solving it. In Claude, stream recovery as observed is poll-based: fast polls, then a slow-poll phase after maxPollAttempts, then 'exhausted'. That recovery path is used for detached or pending replies. 'Resumes the stream first, then polls' was not observed, so drop 'resumes first' or mark it INF. Claude's queue operations are local desktop IPC (LocalSessions), not server-side state shared across replicas.
caveats: Priority for multi-replica safety derives from Verevon's own code, not from any reference
ChatGPT and Manus web queue/steer are DOC-only
